Albuquerque Police Department Standard Operating Procedures.

§ 1-22 Automated License Plate Reader Program.
Effective: 07/17/2023 Review: 07/17/2024 Replaces: 09/08/2021. This SOP establishes the department policy for the automated license plate reader program.
